material_class.structural_family: distorted cubane [Dy4(μ3-OH)4]8+ with six bridging biphenanthrenediolate ligands

synthesis.procedure: R-H2L (23.19 mg, 0.06 mmol) was dissolved in DCM (10 mL), stirred for 2 min, then 1,1,3,3-tetramethylguanidine (15 μL, 0.12 mmol) was added and the mixture was stirred for 10 min. A methanolic solution (1.5 mL) of Dy(NO3)3·5H2O (8.77 mg, 0.02 mmol) was added dropwise and stirring was continued at 25 °C for 20 min. The mixture was filtered through medium-porosity paper into a 20 mL glass vial. Slow vapor diffusion of n-pentane (10 mL) into the DCM solution over 10 days at 25 °C gave yellow X-ray-quality crystals (6.5 mg, 32% based on Dy). Coordination reactions were run in ambient air.
synthesis.time: stirring 2 min + 10 min + 20 min; crystallization 10 days
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 20 mL glass vial; ambient-air solution reaction followed by n-pentane vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtered through medium-porosity paper; slow vapor diffusion of n-pentane (10 mL) into the DCM solution for 10 days at 25 °C afforded yellow crystals.

properties.summary: Room-temperature χMT is close to four uncoupled Dy(III) ions. χMT falls on cooling, sharply below about 50 K, from depopulation of Stark levels plus intramolecular antiferromagnetic interactions and/or anisotropy. Magnetization does not saturate and no hysteresis loop is seen at 1.9 K. Zero-field ac susceptibility shows no χ'' signal, consistent with strong QTM; no χ'' peak appears in a field sweep of the S analogue, so the Dy4 pair is not a field-induced SMM. UV-vis is red-shifted relative to the free ligand with a shoulder near 385 nm, and the CD spectrum is the mirror image of S-Dy4, indicating chirality transfer.

properties.summary: Magnetic behaviour matches the R enantiomer: χMT near the uncoupled Dy4 value decreases on cooling, magnetization is unsaturated, and there is no 1.9 K hysteresis. Zero-field ac data show no χ'', and a field sweep at 1.9 K shows no χ'' peak, so S-Dy4 is dominated by QTM rather than field-induced SMM behaviour. CD is the mirror image of R-Dy4; UV-vis shows the same red shift and shoulder near 385 nm.

properties.summary: χMT at 300 K agrees with four uncoupled Er(III) ions, decreases on cooling, then rises below about 10 K from intramolecular ferromagnetic coupling. Magnetization is unsaturated and there is no hysteresis at 1.9 K. Zero-field ac shows no χ''; under 600 Oe, frequency-dependent χ'' appears below 8 K, identifying a field-induced SMM with a modest Orbach barrier. UV-vis shows a red shift and a shoulder near 385 nm, and CD confirms the enantiomeric relationship with S-Er4.

properties.summary: Isostructural magnetic response to R-Er4: χMT decreases on cooling then increases below about 10 K from ferromagnetic intramolecular coupling; magnetization is unsaturated and hysteresis is absent at 1.9 K. Under 600 Oe it is a field-induced SMM with frequency-dependent χ'' below 8 K and a small Orbach barrier. CD is the mirror image of R-Er4 and UV-vis shows the ligand-to-complex red shift with a shoulder near 385 nm.
